description: This file defines the SqlsrvManager class, a specialized manager for interfacing with SQL Server databases within the SuiteCRM project. It extends the MssqlManager class and implements database connection, query execution, schema inspection, and error handling tailored for the sqlsrv PHP extension.

classes.name: SqlsrvManager
classes.description: A database manager class for Microsoft SQL Server using the sqlsrv PHP extension, providing connection, query, schema management, and error handling functionalities.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the SQL Server database using provided configuration options.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, supporting both string and array inputs, and logs the operation.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the fields (columns) from a query result.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from the result set as an associative array, normalizing empty varchar fields.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Generates SQL conversion expressions, with special handling for datetime types.

methods.name: compareVarDefs
methods.description: Compares two variable definitions, with special handling for 'id' type fields.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the database and performs cleanup.

methods.name: freeDbResult
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a database query result.

methods.name: getConstraintSql
methods.description: Generates SQL to add constraints, ensuring tables have a clustered index.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table, including data types, defaults, and constraints.

methods.name: doesTableHaveAClusteredIndexDefined
methods.description: Checks if a table has a clustered index defined.

methods.name: doesTableHaveAFulltextIndexDefined
methods.description: Checks if a table has a fulltext index defined.

methods.name: changeColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to change a column, removing fulltext indexes if necessary.

methods.name: truncateTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to truncate a table.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Retrieves the last database error message, filtering out non-critical messages.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the database server and client.

methods.name: verifyGenericQueryRollback
methods.description: Runs a data manipulation query inside a transaction, then rolls back to test for errors.

methods.name: verifyInsertInto
methods.description: Tests an INSERT statement for errors via transaction rollback.

methods.name: verifyUpdate
methods.description: Tests an UPDATE statement for errors via transaction rollback.

methods.name: verifyDeleteFrom
methods.description: Tests a DELETE statement for errors via transaction rollback.

methods.name: selectDb
methods.description: Sets the current database context.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the sqlsrv PHP extension is available for use.
